en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a harbor with calm blue water, sailing ships and steam vessels, and a fortified rocky hill crowned with walls and buildings. A waterfront town stretches along the base of the fortifications. Trees and small structures appear in the foreground. At the bottom left, printed text reads "Souvenir de Corfou," with publisher information in smaller print, and there is handwritten cursive text along the lower margin.
